steps.text: At the circuit breaker or fuse panel, turn off the power to the outlet.
Remove the existing outlet and wallplate.
Disconnect the wires from the old outlet and make sure you have 1/2 in. of bare wire on the ends.
Identify the line, neutral and ground wires: turn the power back on, find the line wire with a voltage meter, then turn the breaker off again.
With the included wire nuts, connect the outlet's bare copper ground wire to ground, its white wire to neutral and its black wire to line. A neutral connection is required.
Make sure all wire connectors are firmly attached and no copper is exposed except the ground wire.
Carefully install the outlet into the electrical box and replace the wallplate.
Turn the power back on at the circuit breaker or fuse panel.
Plug the lamp or appliance you want to control into the top (controlled) outlet, with the appliance switched on.
Test the outlet by tapping the SET button a few times.

notes: The top outlet is Insteon-controlled; the bottom outlet is always on.
If the junction box has no neutral wire, consult an electrician.

steps.text: With the controller in linking mode, press and hold the outlet's SET button for 3 seconds.
steps.expect: Status LED flashes once and turns on solid; the load flashes once

notes: The outlet links as a responder: set the controller to linking mode first (for most controllers, press and hold an On or scene button for 10 seconds or the SET button for 3 seconds), then press and hold the outlet's SET button.
Pressing and holding the SET button for 3 seconds on its own puts the outlet in linking mode (Status LED blinks) for four minutes; the manual uses this to assign an X10 address.
With the Hub, follow the app's instructions and press and hold the outlet's SET button when prompted.

steps.text: With the controller in unlinking mode, press and hold the outlet's SET button for 3 seconds.
steps.expect: Status LED flashes once and turns on solid; the load turns on

notes: Set the controller to unlinking mode first (for most controllers, press and hold an On or scene button for 10 seconds twice or the SET button for 3 seconds twice).

steps.text: Unlink the outlet from any controller that controls it.
Press and hold the SET button as you turn off the power at the circuit breaker.
Press and hold the SET button while you restore power at the circuit breaker.
Keep holding the SET button for 3 seconds, then release it.
steps.expect: Status LED turns on bright and solid, then off; after a few seconds it turns on solid

notes: You may need someone to help with the breaker.

If the breaker method is too difficult: tap the SET button until the load is on, press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds (Status LED blinks), wait 3 seconds and quickly tap the SET button five times (Status LED and load turn off), then immediately press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds and release (Status LED flashes once and turns off, then turns on solid a few seconds later).

steps.text: Unlink the outlet from every controller it is linked to.

notes: The manual says to unlink the outlet from all controllers before you stop using it; otherwise the controllers keep retrying commands and slow the system.
